about.title: About & how to use
about.intro: Flyball Team Tracker helps your club plan trainings and competitions: who's coming, which dogs run which tasks, and how your race lineups are built.

tasks.title: Tasks
items: Tasks are laid out on a grid of rows and columns - drag a card to reorder it, or move it into a different cell.
Pick an event at the top to see which dogs are marked present, and to plan tasks against that event's attendance.
A task can list dogs directly, or link to a team lineup instead - tap a linked task to see (and edit) that lineup's cross-pass timing.
Tap a dog's name on a task to add a note, or to open the linked lineup's cross-pass details.

calendar.title: Calendar
items: Every event your club has scheduled - trainings, competitions, seminars, meetings - shows up here, newest first, with the soonest upcoming one pinned at the top so it's never buried further down.
Narrow the list to a date range with the From/To filters, and page through it once there are more events than fit on one screen.
Expand an event's details to mark your own (or your dogs') attendance: tap a name to cycle it through present, absent, and unset.

myDogs.title: My Dogs
items: Each of your dogs gets a card here - add general notes, and manage its cross passes (who it runs on, its starting position, and timing).
Cross passes recorded here are your own record, separate from the cross passes set inside your team's lineups - unless you turn on syncing for a dog in Settings, which keeps the two in step.
If your trainer has set a jump height for a dog, it shows on its card here.

teams.title: Teams
items: A team is a pool of up to 6 dogs your club can build race lineups from.
Each team can have several lineups - a lineup is an ordered set of dogs for a race, with cross-pass timing between each dog.
A lineup's name shows its jump height in brackets, e.g. "Super lineup (25cm)" - automatically the lowest jump height among its dogs (a dog with no height set counts as 35cm).

settings.title: Settings
items: Switch the app's language between Polish and English at any time - your choice is saved to your account.
Change your own password here at any time, with your current password to confirm it's really you.

For each of your own dogs, there are two independent cross-pass syncing options: keep its timing in sync across every lineup it runs in after the same dog, and/or keep it in sync with its standalone My Dogs cross-passes.

trainerSection.title: Trainer tools
trainerSection.intro: As a trainer, you also get a dedicated panel for managing your club's data:
items: Tasks - the same drag-and-drop board, plus the ability to create, edit, and delete tasks.

Dogs, Dog tasks, Users - manage your club's dogs (including each dog's jump height), the task types they can be assigned, and your club's members. Open a member's card to reset their password if they're locked out - you'll get a one-time temporary password to pass along to them.
Events - create trainings, competitions, seminars, and meetings for your club.
Teams - build and edit teams and their lineups for your whole club, not just your own dogs.
